name: Allobarbital
summary: It is a barbiturate that was first made in 1912. It was preliminary used as an anticonvulsant. Yet it has pretty much been outclassed by a newer generation of safer ones. Still in use in Poland.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: It was used primarily as an anticonvulsant although it has now largely been replaced by newer drugs with improved safety profiles. Relative as phenobarbital and secobarbital, althosaw more use in some European countries such as Bulgaria and Slovakia. In Poland, it was used until the 2010s, but only as compound.

summaryZh: 二烯丙巴比妥是一種巴比妥類藥物，分子式C10H12N2O3，是汽巴精化的科學家Ernst Preiswerk和Ernst Grether在1912年研發，主要用作抗驚厥藥。
summaryZhHans: 二烯丙巴比妥是一种巴比妥类药物，分子式C10H12N2O3，是汽巴精化的科学家Ernst Preiswerk和Ernst Grether在1912年研发，主要用作抗惊厥药。

pharmacology.en: Like other barbiturates, it binds to the GABA-A receptor and keeps its chloride channel open for longer. This strongly dampens brain activity, causing sedation and preventing seizures.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他巴比妥類一樣，它與 GABA-A 受體結合，使受體的氯離子通道開啟更久，強烈抑制腦部活動，造成鎮靜並防止癲癇發作。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他巴比妥类一样，它与 GABA-A 受体结合，使受体的氯离子信道打开更久，强烈抑制脑部活动，造成镇静并防止癫痫发作。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, poor coordination and confusion. Overdose can stop breathing and be fatal. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、協調變差與混亂。過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、协调制差与混乱。过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作。

fact.en: Barbiturates take their name from barbituric acid, first made by the German chemist Adolf von Baeyer in 1864. Allobarbital is barbituric acid with two allyl groups attached.
fact.zh: 巴比妥類藥物的名稱來自巴比妥酸，由德國化學家 Adolf von Baeyer 於 1864 年首次合成。二烯丙巴比妥就是在巴比妥酸上接了兩個烯丙基。
fact.zhHans: 巴比妥类药物的名称来自巴比妥酸，由德国化学家 Adolf von Baeyer 于 1864 年首次合成。二烯丙巴比妥就是在巴比妥酸上接了两个烯丙基。
